steps.evaluate: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('[data-filelist-identifier="1:/desiderio-styleguide/desiderio-target-groups.docx"]'); const target = row.querySelector('button[data-filelist-action="primary"], a, .resource-tile, td') || row; target.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); const box = target.getBoundingClientRect(); target.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true, view: window, button: 2, buttons: 2, clientX: box.left + 20, clientY: box.top + 10 })); })()

const mark = (x, y, w, h) => { let m = document.getElementById('shot-clip'); if (!m) { m = document.createElement('div'); m.id = 'shot-clip'; document.body.append(m); } Object.assign(m.style, { position: 'fixed', left: Math.round(x) + 'px', top: Math.round(y) + 'px', width: Math.round(w) + 'px', height: Math.round(h) + 'px', pointerEvents: 'none', zIndex: '-1' }); }; const mark16 = (x, y, maxWidth) => { const w = Math.floor(maxWidth / 16) * 16; mark(x, y, w, w / 1.6); }; const frameBox = () => document.querySelector('iframe#typo3-contentIframe').getBoundingClientRect(); const frameDoc = () => document.querySelector('iframe#typo3-contentIframe').contentDocument; (() => { const f = frameBox(); mark16(f.left, f.top, f.width); })()
